tooltip.pve_token: Proxmox VE API token in full user@realm!tokenid=secret form. Recommended: a read-only token with the PVEAuditor role. A privilege-separated token needs its own ACL entry (pveum acl modify / --tokens '<id>' --roles PVEAuditor).

settings.label_font_note: Applies to graph node and connection labels only. Connection labels are drawn two steps smaller. The detail panel and the rest of the interface keep their own font.
settings.diagram_note: Diagram mode draws right-angled connections and turns Animate off. Arrange lays the map out once; nodes stay draggable afterwards and the arrangement is saved.

admin.update.disclosure: While this is off, the installation makes no outbound connection. When it is on, it fetches the manifest once a day: your public IP address is visible to the host serving it and is never stored, and the product version and country are counted in aggregate. No identifier, cookie or usage data is sent.
admin.update.urls_hint: Tried in order. You can host a copy of this file on your own server and point here instead — the installation then makes no outbound connection to the vendor.
admin.update.trust.note_tls: Trusted if the manifest is served over HTTPS with a valid certificate. Any signature in the file is ignored — appropriate when you host the manifest yourself.
admin.update.trust.note_tls_sig: Also requires a valid ed25519 signature, verified against the vendor keys bundled in this image. If the signature is missing or invalid the fetch is rejected and the previous result is kept.
admin.update.trust.note_pinned_sig: As TLS + signature, and the URL used by the first successful fetch is pinned. No other URL is tried afterwards. Clear the pin before changing the manifest URL.
admin.api_tokens.note: Bearer tokens for the northbound API (/api/v1/). Each token is shown in plaintext exactly once at creation — copy it before closing the dialog.
